achievements.name: Beacon Beach
achievements.detail: Clear Beacon Beach, the first planet, by winning the battle inside its lighthouse.

achievements.name: Edge Joins
achievements.detail: Recruit Edge on Beacon Beach and bring her into the battle party.

achievements.name: Pristine Peaks
achievements.detail: Clear Pristine Peaks and rid the snowy planet of Darkmess.

achievements.name: Palette Prime
achievements.detail: Clear Palette Prime, the planet the Darkmess has drained of color.

achievements.name: Terra Flora
achievements.detail: Clear Terra Flora and free the forest planet from the Darkmess.

achievements.name: Barrendale Mesa
achievements.detail: Clear Barrendale Mesa and sweep the Darkmess off that western planet.

achievements.name: Melodic Gardens
achievements.detail: Clear Melodic Gardens and drive the Darkmess out of the music planet.

achievements.name: Spark Equipped
achievements.detail: Rescue a Spark and equip it so a hero can call on its power.

achievements.name: Darkmess Eye
achievements.detail: Destroy a Darkmess Eye while fighting through a corrupted battlefield.

achievements.name: Skill Prism
achievements.detail: Spend a Skill Prism to unlock a new upgrade on a hero's Skill Tree.

achievements.name: Giant Enemy
achievements.detail: Defeat a Giant enemy and earn the Gold Prism left by that battle.

achievements.name: Final Battle
achievements.detail: Win the last battle and stop the Darkmess from spreading.
